name: Civic Accessibility Toolbar
description: Creates a block with options to resize text and change color contrast.
project_description:
Civic Accessibility Toolbar provides a block with accessibility utilities to help end-users to switch between theme versions with higher color contrast and change font size of text.

 The module allows you to create a block with both or one of the utilities to help visual impaired users accessing your Drupal site.

 All theme font sizes must use rem or em units, for the font resize utility to work as expected.

 The module is tested with Bartik, Garland, Zen Starterkit, Stark, Oliveiro themes.

 The module uses cookies (colourContrast and fontSize) to remember user selection. These cookies don't retain any personal information and can be classified as functional/necessary cookies. If you use any cookie control tool please protect these cookies.
